text: {Name} earned a living playing at weddings before enlisting for regular wages. Posted near {Place}, the musician hoped to leave the army and earn money performing again.
self_review: A wedding musician joined the army for steady wages and hoped to return to paid performances.
source_pattern: The supplied Sierra Leone TRC findings describe recruits entering the army for monthly pay.
fictional_changes: The music work, wedding performances, military posting, and hope of returning to that work are fictional. The wage motive is the documented general pattern.
